extracted.name: Iceberg Lettuce Wedges with Ranch Dressing
extracted.description: One of my favourite salads to serve when I'm entertaining because it looks impressive and it takes all of 5 seconds to chop!
ingredient_lines: 1/4 cup whole egg mayonnaise ((if using normal, omit the lemon juice))
instruction_lines: Combine the Ranch Dressing ingredients in a bowl and whisk until smooth.
Transfer to a jug and refrigerate until required.
To serve, place the iceberg wedges onto a plate with the dressing on the side.
